speaker: JBL Professional PRX635
acceptanceScope: Provisional engineering screen selected before processing: held-out horizontal relative band response only. Not a universal industry tolerance or field-accuracy claim.
coordinateMapping: Published positive angle is speaker-left viewed from behind; source faces +X; +Z is speaker-right; receiver z=-r*sin(angle). Elevation Y=0. No vertical data are inferred.
calibration: 3D3A manual: B&K 4189-A-021 microphone, B&K 4231 calibrator, -11 dBFS=94 dB SPL; spectral level=20log10(abs(DFT))+105. Electrical drive and operating preset not documented. Only on-axis-normalized ratios are compared.
limitations: One unit, one session, one horizontal orbit and one radius; held-out angles share the measurement chain with training angles.
Unknown electrical drive, undocumented system preset and atmosphere; no absolute SPL, maximum output or independent-session validation.
Paper chamber quarter-wavelength limit about 425 Hz; 4 ms time window limits frequency resolution. No low-frequency extrapolation.
Band powers recomputed from original windowed IRs; published 1/24-octave plots are not used as numerical reference.
Magnitude-only data do not validate inter-source phase, array coherence, reflections, scattering or distance extrapolation.
